rows.notes: The cited document is a literature review with a meta-analysis of 128 paired observations from 30 published studies; it reports no field, laboratory, survey or model data of its own. Statements about drip irrigation leaching salts (Section 2.2.1) are attributed to other work (Hanson et al. [79], Marchand and Abd El Hadi [78]) and the meta-analysis pools literature values, so no primary evidence exists for the claim that drainage plus drip irrigation leaches salts from the root zone. Q1 is 'no', so all other questions are 'no'.
